title: A new identity for Birdcar
question: Choose a direction for the marketing site. Each keeps Alkaline and Barlow, the free assessment and a report clients can keep. Admin and customer UI retain Flux UI Pro and Inter. These are design proposals, not finished pages.

options.label: The project folio
options.lineage: Tabbed project folders and working reports
options.thesis: The useful plan you give clients becomes the organizing idea for the brand.
options.viewport: An open illustrative assessment report meets a large Alkaline headline and a visible booking action; tabs lead into the work and care process.
options.risk: Too many tabs could make the brand feel like administration; the report stays the single focal object.

raised.raise: Every layer has one clear job and an unmistakable active state.
The discovery-to-care sequence remains legible across the whole page.
One dominant report composition owns the opening; secondary content holds still.
Each project stays attached to its real people and evidence.
The composition uses confident asymmetry while preserving a single reading order.

options.label: Good work, close to home
options.thesis: A capable local partner with a confident, unmistakably human voice.
options.viewport: A broad evergreen opening carries generous Alkaline lettering beside a lime assessment invitation, followed by clear service stages and real project stories.
options.risk: The familiar local-service language is effective but less unexpected, and must avoid suggesting a trade-only business.

options.label: Make room
options.lineage: Jazz-session title cards and asymmetric color panels
options.thesis: Give overloaded work a clear rhythm through bold, purposeful changes of scene.
options.viewport: A narrow section index borders an oversized Alkaline promise on mustard; a contrasting panel makes the free assessment and take-away plan explicit.
options.case: Competitive on product clarity: the panels rank the promise, action and next step decisively; more theatrical for some owners.
options.risk: Can read as an entertainment brand unless the operational problem and offer lead every composition; Alkaline replaces the source's colliding display caps.

options.label: One-bit desktop
options.thesis: Organize the assessment, project and care relationship as distinct desktop windows.
options.viewport: An assessment window opens over a visible report and project folder, with the booking action in the active window.
options.case: Weaker on audience identification and immediate product clarity: it asks buyers to decode a retro computer interface before the service.
options.risk: Computer nostalgia could dominate the business problem.

options.label: Rhythm machine
options.thesis: A visible sequence shows how repeated work can run reliably.
options.viewport: A step row illustrates a sample client workflow under a plain service promise and assessment action.
options.case: Weaker on identification and clarity: instrument controls suggest another tool to operate when the owner needs a responsible partner.
options.risk: The demonstration could become a toy that delays the conversation.

options.label: The threshold
options.thesis: Visualize the point where growing work overwhelms the system holding it together.
materials: Alkaline display on a quiet plane
options.viewport: One contained gravity illustration accompanies the overload problem and a stable assessment action outside the motion.
options.case: Weaker on identification and clarity: cosmic failure and irreversible loss undermine an approachable, reversible first engagement.
options.risk: Spectacle and anxiety could overwhelm the practical offer.

options.label: Memory quilt
options.thesis: Keep people and their contribution visible as separate systems are joined together.
options.viewport: An unequal patch grid associates a client's work, people and next step, with the assessment invitation on one continuous patch.
options.case: Weaker on identification and clarity: domestic-memory imagery and patchwork could suggest preserving the piecemeal systems the buyer wants to improve.
options.kept: Human context and provenance stay attached to each project.
options.risk: Material nostalgia may communicate a craft archive instead of operational help.

options.label: Dada collage
options.thesis: Bring scattered fragments of work into a visible, actionable plan.
materials: Alkaline and Barlow replacing mixed font cases
options.viewport: Illustrative fragments of a workflow surround one clean report and the assessment action.
options.case: Weaker on identification and clarity: competing scraps reproduce the attention burden the offer should relieve.
options.risk: Visual disorder could make the business seem harder to work with.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A familiar professional-services site with a clear promise, process and project evidence.
canonCard.viewport: A standard navigation bar, spacious split hero, assessment button, process section and project summaries.
canonCard.risk: Familiar by design, with less visual differentiation from other consultancies.
